designated_reviewer.note: The designated second reviewer (an external, automated, read-only code review) was AVAILABLE for the first time in five phases. Phases 7, 8, 9 and 10 each recorded it rate-limited and substituted the fallback reviewer; Phase 10's handoff stated that four consecutive phases was not an accident and that this stack should get an independent human review, or a pass by the designated second reviewer, before merge.
designated_reviewer.method: Three batches of Phase 11's own claims, each prompted to REFUTE by default and to correct any claim that was real but overstated. The designated second reviewer ran read-only in the worktree and reproduced results independently rather than reading alone.

refuted_as_written.claim: P11-OWN-02 - 'nothing declares or asserts' the engine-identity precondition
refuted_as_written.correction: False. engine/worker_entrypoint.sh:6 calls engine_identity() before starting Celery and docs/compliance/phase-3/README.md:121 documents the identity sources. Verified. The accurate finding is that the TEST suites lack an identity fixture or preflight for a source export. Severity reduced high -> medium. The designated second reviewer also corrected the failure attribution: the two non-engine failures span backend-api/tests and tools/tests, not two backend tests.

refuted_as_written.claim: P11-OWN-21 - 'no phase of this programme has verified' v3.1.0, v4.0.0 or essential-eight
refuted_as_written.correction: False. engine/tests/test_wiring.py:66 enumerates all metadata structurally, the Essential Eight family has semantic Rego tests (e.g. test_e8_priv_1_1_restrict_admin_privileges.rego), and backend-api/tests/test_phase7_soc2.py:386 exercises v3.1.0 scan behaviour. The accurate finding is incomplete semantic coverage, not zero verification. Severity reduced high -> medium. The 22-of-69 count was independently reproduced.

refuted_as_written.claim: P11-OWN-10 - CodeQL is not a pull-request gate for anything outside security/
refuted_as_written.correction: FALSE, and the finding is WITHDRAWN IN FULL. ci.backend-api.yml:36-43, ci.engine.yml:31-37 and ci.frontend.yml:31-38 each run codeql-action/init and analyze on `pull_request: branches: [main]` with no path filter. Verified directly. ci.security.yml's filter is exactly what its comment says: that workflow exists only to scan the unmaintained security/ TPRM module.

refuted_as_written.claim: P11-OWN-18 - the product implements neither NIST nor ISO 27001
refuted_as_written.correction: Overstated as a blanket claim. security/strategies/custom_benchmarks.py:83 NISTComplianceChecker and :91 ISO27001Checker are registered at :143/:150 and reachable through evidence.py's strategy resolver. They are keyword checkers over an uploaded document carrying one rule each, in the unmaintained TPRM module - not a benchmark. The finding is restated to say exactly that and its severity reduced from high to medium.

refuted_as_written.claim: P11-OWN-03 - merged, Alembic refuses to load the versions directory at all
refuted_as_written.correction: Wrong mechanism. alembic/script/revision.py:212 WARNS on a duplicate revision id and loads anyway; the failure is at head resolution on the combined graph, which the designated second reviewer reproduced in memory. `alembic upgrade head` still fails, and with it entrypoint.sh:5. Explicit revision targets remain resolvable. Corrected.

corrected.correction: Rego produces ZERO bindings for string membership; it does not iterate the string's four characters. The fabricated 4 comes from count(shared_mailboxes) over the string's length on a different line. The observed false pass is unchanged and the designated second reviewer reproduced it, including under the worker's --strict-builtin-errors.

Overstated. A collection failure or non-object evidence (tasks.py:894) fails those controls earlier, for a different reason, without reaching the policy. The accurate statement is 'whenever evaluation is reached'.

corrected.claim: P11-OWN-01 - '19 errors that have no auto-fix'
corrected.correction: No SAFE auto-fix; six carry unsafe fixes ruff will not apply without --unsafe-fixes. The designated second reviewer independently reproduced the same 19 errors and distribution under ruff 0.8.0. Its read-only replay predicted 223 modified files against the 221 observed by actually running the hooks.

adversarial_pass.method: Fourteen independent verification dimensions ran in parallel over the integrated stack. Every candidate finding then faced three refuters with distinct lenses - code truth, test-and-config truth, and scenario reachability - each defaulting to REFUTED. A finding survives only if fewer than two of its three refuters refute it.

notable_refutations.reason: All three refuters confirmed every fact and rejected the finding as an externally blocked human decision already recorded as blocked. Correct as a DEFECT classification. It is still carried in acceptance-criteria.json as criterion 12 NOT MET, because for a release decision an unapproved crosswalk is an unmet criterion whatever its cause.
Same reasoning, same resolution: not a defect, still an unmet criterion.

notable_refutations.finding: REPRO-1 - collector output is never stored, so no scan is re-derivable
notable_refutations.reason: Refuted as a deliberate, D05-permitted refusal, and as overstating what the stored provenance supports. Accepted. traceability-trace.md records the break in the chain without calling it a defect.

notable_refutations.finding: T-01 - no SOC 2 evidence pack generator exists
notable_refutations.reason: Refuted: GET /v1/scans/{scan_id}/soc2-report does exist. The accurate residue - that nothing in the product calls it - is P11-OWN-22.

notable_refutations.finding: DOC-01 - the About page advertises NIST and ISO 27001
notable_refutations.reason: Refuted on its causal mechanism and its 'the site contradicts itself' hook, NOT on its facts: both refuters confirmed the page lists NIST and ISO 27001 and that neither is implemented. Phase 11 verified that directly and carries the fact alone as P11-OWN-18.

adversarial_pass.counts_the_pass_got_wrong: Two survivors disagreed on how many ready policies violate the affected_resources contract - one said 20, another said 12. Phase 11 counted it directly: NINE never emit the field, and NINE MORE omit it only from their `default result`, giving 18 that can emit a contract-invalid result. The designated second reviewer reproduced the first nine independently. The register carries the verified figure and folds both survivors into P11-OWN-14.

phase_11_own_findings.method: Verified directly rather than by reading: starting the containers, evaluating the policies with the digest-verified OPA 1.20.2 binary, running the CI gate the way CI runs it, exporting a checkout with no .git, scanning the built images, and querying the GitHub API.
